svg.title: a freshly generated project passes its own quality gate — a worker reports real task progress and preserves failures
svg.text: a freshly generated project passes its own quality gate
Scenario: a worker reports real task progress and preserves failures

g.text: Given a task emits real output before failing
GitLab shows the disposable Taskfile.yml: the probe prints "native task output", then exits
When the worker reports the output and keeps the failed task status
The real GitLab job is Failed. The test checks that the worker forwards every byte of the
task output and preserves its failure.
Then the failed CI job trace remains available after project cleanup
Delete the disposable project, then read its saved CI trace. The real task output and
failure remain available, with fixture credentials redacted.

svg.text: Storyboard e2e · 3 steps · 3 frames · every frame is its own pixel baseline (tolerance: 0)
